g.text: One request through every layer, and the parts beside it: what enters, what computes, what refuses, what is stored
what actually runs on the host
one question, one kind of answer
the only output the system signs
names the rule and the place
what it can and cannot claim
the parts outside the demo path
a write from the old one
weakening them is not a fix
How to read this sheet, and the five laws it encodes
Each band is one stage. Read it left to right: context, input, mechanism, refusal, output. Horizontal arrows order
the reading, not a dependency; the middle column is the spine, and following it down traces one request from a
question to a stored event. A refusal is a designed outcome, not a missing arrow. Bands 02–15 are that path; 16–17
stores beside it. The laws: a citation is exact text, never a summary; a challenge narrows, never confirms; every
traversal names its limit; the candidate generator sees a projection, not state; INCONCLUSIVE is the only signed
classification. Everything below the mechanism column is a contract, and every contract here refuses something.
Read from backend/*.py, backend/app/*.py, tests and AGENTS.md on 2026-10-31; case counts from the local suite.
